vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are taken by hand (see pnpm-workspace.yaml): pnpm's release age would block the lockfile update, and an open [SECURITY] PR shows publicly that the repository is exposed

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Automerge devDependency updates (minor + patch). CI (lint + build + tests) is the merge gate; majors stay manual for review.
Group pnpm updates across .mise.toml and package.json packageManager field into a single PR
Pin digests for all GitHub Actions
Do not pin digests for GitHub Inc. namespaces (actions/*, github/*)
Our own images follow releases through the latest tag and the deploy webhook: never pinned
Automerge Docker image digest refreshes (same tag, rebuilt base). The docker CI job builds the image.
Prisma CLI and client must move together. Never automerged: the CLI runs the migrations in production.

7.10.x skipped: from 7.10.0 the prisma CLI is published with a token, without the provenance of earlier releases (https://github.com/prisma/orm/pull/30035), which pnpm's trustPolicy rejects. 8.x is offered again (its release candidates carry provenance); pnpm still rejects any release that does not. Drop the rule once a 7.10.x release is attested (npm view prisma@<version> dist.attestations), or once on 8.
Build tooling compiles the shipped code or runs on contributors' machines: reviewed by hand
A Postgres major needs a data migration (pg_upgrade or dump/restore): only on request from the dependency dashboard
